description.zh: 全程地端、不呼叫任何雲端 API 的 YouTube Shorts 產線：一句題材 → 分鏡腳本 → 分鏡圖 → 旁白 → 1080×1920 mp4，在 16GB MacBook 上執行，每支片邊際成本為零。
description.en: A fully local YouTube Shorts pipeline with zero cloud API calls: one-line topic → storyboard script → frames → narration → 1080×1920 mp4, running on a 16 GB MacBook at zero marginal cost per video.

zh: 編劇流程：編劇 → 監製審稿 → 改稿 → 程式硬檢查 → 自動修復
12 項不依賴 LLM 自評的硬檢查把關品質
角色以設定檔定義並固定 seed，跨鏡頭、跨集維持一致
各階段可中斷續跑，提供 Web UI 與 CLI
en: Writer → producer review → rewrite → hard checks → auto-repair loop
12 deterministic checks that don't rely on the LLM grading itself
Characters defined in config with fixed seeds for cross-shot, cross-episode consistency
Resumable at every stage; Web UI and CLI

description.zh: 分層模型委派的 Claude Code Plugin：主對話由 Opus 理解與規劃，執行派給 Sonnet、唯讀檢索交給 Haiku，以 subagent 隔離 context 降低成本。
description.en: A Claude Code plugin for tiered model delegation: Opus plans in the main thread, Sonnet executes, Haiku handles read-only lookups — subagents isolate context to cut cost.

zh: 依任務性質自動分派 Opus / Sonnet / Haiku
跨對話累積的 Markdown 記憶庫：索引只放觸發條件，知識放主題檔
關鍵詞檢索實作不需向量資料庫的輕量 RAG
可透過 plugin marketplace 安裝
en: Routes work to Opus / Sonnet / Haiku by task type
Markdown memory that persists across sessions — the index holds triggers, topic files hold knowledge
Keyword retrieval as a lightweight RAG with no vector database
Installable from the plugin marketplace

description.zh: 結合位置型任務遊戲、通勤助理與叫車的手機 App 原型。以 React + Capacitor 打包為 iOS / Android，後端以 Hono 串接 LLM。
description.en: A mobile app prototype combining location-based quests, a commute assistant and ride-hailing. React + Capacitor for iOS / Android, with a Hono backend calling an LLM.

zh: 地圖任務點：走到附近即可解任務（MapLibre）
對話式通勤助理，串接 TDX 真實捷運資料並附天氣與帶傘建議
估算計程車車資並完成叫車流程
Docker Compose 部署 PostgreSQL
en: Map quests that unlock when you walk nearby (MapLibre)
Conversational commute planner on live TDX metro data, with weather and umbrella hints
Taxi fare estimates and a booking flow
PostgreSQL deployed with Docker Compose

description.zh: 以 Go 開發的跨平台 AI 上下文編排器：在邊緣裝置執行 nelo push，自動掃描專案原始碼並同步至中央 Hub，於 Dashboard 管理、合併並輸出成適合餵給 LLM 的上下文。
description.en: A cross-platform AI context orchestrator in Go: run `nelo push` on an edge device to scan source code and sync it to a central Hub, then curate, merge and export LLM-ready context from the dashboard.

zh: 跨平台支援 — Raspberry Pi 4 / Linux / Windows
自動掃描並合併專案 codebase，減少手動整理
Web Dashboard 即時更新（前端 polling 架構）
localStorage 狀態持久化，重整不遺失資料
CLI 指令 nelo push，一鍵同步至 Hub
en: Cross-platform — Raspberry Pi 4 / Linux / Windows
Auto-scans and merges codebase, eliminating manual cleanup
Real-time Web Dashboard with frontend polling
localStorage persistence across page reloads
CLI command `nelo push` for one-click Hub sync

description.zh: 大學專題：針對藥品與疫苗冷鏈保存，整合環境感測、PLC 控制、即時影像與 LLM Function Calling，做環境分析、異常警報與操作建議。
description.en: Capstone project for pharmaceutical and vaccine cold chains: environmental sensing, PLC control, live video and LLM function calling for analysis, alerts and recommendations.

zh: DHT22、ENS160、PM10 感測器經 MQTT 回傳溫濕度、CO₂ 與顆粒物
PLC 透過 Modbus/TCP 控制灑水
IP Camera 經 RTSP → WebRTC 於網頁即時監看
LLM Function Calling（OpenAI 與地端 LLM）＋ Grafana 儀表板
成果發表於數位生活科技研討會
en: DHT22, ENS160 and PM10 sensors report temperature, humidity, CO₂ and particulates over MQTT
PLC sprinkler control over Modbus/TCP
IP camera streamed RTSP → WebRTC to the browser
LLM function calling (OpenAI or local LLM) with a Grafana dashboard
Presented at the Digital Life Technology Seminar

description.zh: 整合 Google ADK 與 Gemini 模型的 LINE 聊天機器人，支援 Function Calling 與繁體中文優化，可部署至 Docker / GCP Cloud Run。
description.en: A LINE chatbot integrating Google ADK and Gemini, supporting Function Calling and Traditional Chinese optimization. Deployable to Docker / GCP Cloud Run.

zh: Google Gemini AI 回應生成
Function Calling 自訂工具擴充
FastAPI 非同步架構
en: Google Gemini AI response generation
Custom tool extension via Function Calling
Async FastAPI architecture

description.zh: 基於 Gemini API 的 Chrome 瀏覽器擴充功能，為日常瀏覽體驗注入 AI 輔助能力。
description.en: A Chrome extension powered by the Gemini API that injects AI-assisted capabilities into everyday browsing.

zh: Chrome Extension Manifest V3 架構
Gemini API 整合與呼叫
輕量化 CSS 樣式，零外部依賴
en: Chrome Extension Manifest V3 architecture
Gemini API integration
Lightweight CSS, zero external dependencies

description.zh: React + Vite 打造的個人網站。build 階段為每條路由產生實體 HTML，解決 SPA 子頁面被搜尋引擎當成 404 的問題；另外內建一套只跑在本機的內容編輯器 —— 線上是純靜態，沒有任何需要維護的端點。
description.en: A personal site built with React and Vite. The build step emits real HTML for every route, fixing the SPA problem where sub-pages return 404 to crawlers. It also ships a local-only content editor — the deployed site stays fully static, with no endpoint to maintain.

zh: build 時為每條路由產生靜態 HTML，子頁面回應 200 而非 404
dev-only 內容編輯器（Vite middleware + Node API），production build 完全不含
圖片上傳自動依 EXIF 轉正、限制寬度並轉為 WebP
全站文案抽離成 JSON，支援中英雙語切換
GitHub Actions 自動建置並部署至 GitHub Pages
en: Build-time static HTML per route — sub-pages return 200, not 404
Dev-only content editor (Vite middleware + Node API), absent from production builds
Uploaded images auto-rotated by EXIF, width-capped and converted to WebP
All copy extracted to JSON with zh / en switching
Automated build and deploy to GitHub Pages via GitHub Actions

description.zh: 以 Flask 串接 ChatGPT API 的 Telegram 機器人，快速部署至 Vercel serverless 平台，作為早期 AI 整合實作練習。
description.en: A Telegram bot connecting ChatGPT API via Flask, deployed to Vercel serverless — an early AI integration exercise.

zh: ChatGPT API 串接與回應處理
Vercel serverless 一鍵部署
Telegram Bot API 訊息收發
en: ChatGPT API integration and response handling
One-click Vercel serverless deployment
Telegram Bot API messaging
